summary: Outbound engine: adaptive concurrency (AIMD + latency floor, drain epochs, priority queue), learned request rate (ceiling memory, hold/probe, slow start, short-horizon GCRA), token budgets, breaker (hard window + recent-span outage), retries (full jitter, budget, Retry-After, idempotency keys), pooled keep-alive clients. Useful-throughput benchmark recorded vs a naive client (rate-limited, overload, outage, keep-alive, concurrency sweep). Algorithm documented in docs/architecture/outbound-engine.md and ADR 0005. Unresolved: rate-limit header parsing (x-ratelimit-*, IETF RateLimit) would remove learning pauses.

validation.evidence: cargo test -p app-networking: 26 unit/property + 8 engine tests passed (2026-10-04)
benchmarks/baseline.json suites.outbound: engine 100% completion at 429-limited and overloaded providers, waste 1.9% / 0.2% vs naive 99.5% / 98.8%; outage amplification 0.48x vs 21x
